title: Noise Steering: Exploiting Wake Steering and Acoustic Directivity for Noise-Constrained Wind Farm Control via Reinforcement Learning
title_zh: 噪声转向：通过强化学习利用尾流转向与声学指向性实现噪声约束下的风电场控制

paragraphs.en: Existing noise mitigation strategies for wind farms usually consist in reducing turbines power output, without accounting for the wake interactions between them and the noise emission directivity. This leads to over-conservative policies and unexploited wind power. Yet, turbine yaw can simultaneously affect wake interactions and the direction of noise emission, offering an additional degree of freedom for farm-level noise control. We therefore propose Noise Steering , a model-free reinforcement learning (RL) strategy that jointly controls turbine yaw angles and power setpoints to maximise farm power while satisfying a local noise constraint in a defined region. To enable training at a reduced computational cost, a low-fidelity acoustic model is coupled with the steady-state FLORIS simulator. The RL agent effectively learns how to redirect wakes and noise directivity away from the protected region while redistributing power across the farm. On a six-turbine test farm, the policy satisfies the 40 dB 40\text{\,}\mathrm{dB} noise constraint throughout the full range of turbulent winds, with an average power deficit of only 2% relative to greedy unimpeded control , and up to 7.7% at high wind speeds. In comparison, the industry-standard noise-reduced operation (NRO) baseline here generates an average power loss of 17%. When deployed in the higher-fidelity FAST.Farm simulator, the policy largely retains its performance under steady and turbulent inflow, despite differences in simulation fidelity. These results demonstrate the potential of combining yaw control and power derating through RL to improve the power-noise trade-off in wind farm operation.
paragraphs.zh: 现有的风电场噪声缓解策略通常是通过降低风机功率输出来实现，而没有考虑风机之间的尾流相互作用以及噪声排放的方向性。 这导致了过于保守的策略和未被利用的风电。 然而，风机偏航可以同时影响尾流相互作用和噪声排放的方向，为风电场级噪声控制提供了一个额外的自由度。 因此，我们提出了 Noise Steering，一种无模型强化学习（RL）策略，它联合控制风机偏航角和功率设定值，以在满足指定区域的局部噪声约束的同时最大化风电场功率。 为了在较低的计算成本下实现训练，我们将低保真度声学模型与稳态 FLORIS 仿真器耦合。 该强化学习智能体有效地学会了如何将尾流和噪声指向性从受保护区域引开，同时在风电场内重新分配功率。 在一个六风机测试风电场上，该策略在全范围湍流风况下均满足 40 dB 40\text{\,}\mathrm{dB} 的噪声约束，相对于贪婪无阻碍控制的平均功率损失仅为 2%，在高风速下最大为 7.7%。 相比之下，作为对比的行业标准降噪运行（NRO）基线平均产生 17% 的功率损失。 当部署在保真度更高的 FAST.Farm 仿真器中时，尽管仿真保真度存在差异，该策略在稳态和湍流入流下基本保持了其性能。 这些结果证明了通过强化学习结合偏航控制和功率降额来改善风电场运行中功率-噪声权衡的潜力。

paragraphs.en: Existing noise mitigation strategies mainly operate at the turbine level. Blade design optimisation [ 5 , 23 ] and other approaches, such as blade trailing edge serrations [ 10 ] , have been explored. On the turbine control side, industry standards define noise-reduced operation (NRO) modes for individual turbines [ 44 ] , effectively limiting their rotational speed and power output. [ 14 ] provide an example of acoustic curtailment look-up table used to control the turbines. Model predictive control was used in [ 40 ] to find the optimal turbine controls (blade pitch and generator torque) to satisfy a noise level constraint. At the farm level, noise mitigation has mainly been addressed through layout optimisation [ 8 , 48 ] and optimisation of individual NRO levels [ 39 , 33 , 42 ] . Moreover, Shah et al. [39] define uniform power derating of the turbines as a common control strategy by wind farm operators. These methods enable compliance with the noise regulation but reduce power generation of the wind farm, which leads to reduced revenue in real operation. The median loss in annual energy production (AEP) was estimated to be of 2.8% in France between 2020 and 2022 [ 46 ] .

paragraphs.en: Meanwhile, an important share of wind farm control studies focuses on wake steering for power maximisation of the wind farm [ 4 ] . By misaligning turbines, yaw control redirects their wakes and can reduce velocity deficits for downstream turbines. Yaw control can also modify the spatial distribution (or directivity) of turbine noise. Wind turbine noise exhibits a dipole radiation pattern approximately aligned with the rotor axis (i.e., maximum with respect to the rotor normal) [ 34 , 35 ] , such that yawing a turbine changes the direction of maximum noise emission. The potential of exploiting noise directivity in wind farm operations has recently been highlighted by Shah et al. [39] . However, existing noise-reduction control strategies rely only on power adjustments and do not exploit turbine yaw control [ 14 ] . In this article, we extend the wake steering strategy, which targets power maximisation, to a novel farm-level noise-reduced operation strategy, referred to as Noise Steering . By controlling the yaw angles and NRO levels of the wind turbines, this control technique can maximise power generation while respecting a localised noise constraint.
paragraphs.zh: 与此同时，风电场控制研究中相当一部分聚焦于尾流偏转，以实现风电场的功率最大化 [ 4 ] 。 通过使风轮机偏航错开，偏航控制可以改变其尾流方向，并降低下游风轮机处的速度亏损。 偏航控制还可以改变风轮机噪声的空间分布（即指向性）。 风轮机噪声呈现出大致与风轮轴对齐的偶极子辐射模式（即最大值位于风轮法线方向）[ 34 , 35 ] ，因此偏航风轮机会改变噪声最大发射的方向。 Shah 等人 [39] 最近强调了在风电场运行中利用噪声指向性的潜力。 然而，现有的降噪控制策略仅依赖功率调节，并未利用风轮机偏航控制 [ 14 ] 。 在本文中，我们将以功率最大化为目标的尾流偏转策略扩展为一种新颖的场级降噪运行策略，称为 Noise Steering 。 通过控制风轮机的偏航角与 NRO 水平，该控制技术可以在满足局部噪声约束的前提下最大化发电量。

paragraphs.en: Wind farm control has traditionally focused on model-based control to coordinate turbines within a farm [ 25 ] . These approaches can similarly be applied to Noise Steering , for example through Model Predictive Control or offline model-based optimisation. However, these methods are limited by the precision of their underlying model and generally require solving an optimisation problem for each operating condition. Reinforcement Learning (RL) has recently emerged as a promising data-driven alternative [ 12 , 1 ] , with the potential to provide a model-free closed-loop controller whose policy is computationally inexpensive to evaluate once trained and that can continue to learn and adapt online when deployed on a wind farm.

paragraphs.en: To address this gap, we propose a cooperative wind farm RL control to perform Noise Steering . RL training requires a large number of simulations, making high-fidelity noise evaluation (e.g. Large Eddy Simulation of farms, [ 37 ] ) computationally prohibitive. Therefore, we extend the steady-state FLORIS simulator [ 16 ] with a low-fidelity acoustic model to efficiently estimate farm-level noise emissions. We combine the analytical model of Hagg [17] with an enforced dipole directivity, and validate it against FAST.Farm BPM acoustic model [ 7 ] . The RL agent learns to maximise farm power production while respecting a noise constraint, namely a maximum sound level allowed at a protected receiver region near the farm. Unlike turbine-level NRO or static layout optimisation, our formulation allows the agent to combine both yaw misalignment and power derating for each turbine. This enables to increase power generation compared to standard strategies by reducing wake interactions and redirecting noise directivity patterns away from the protected region. The policy, trained exclusively under steady inflow in FLORIS, is then deployed without retraining in the higher-fidelity dynamic simulator FAST.Farm, both under steady and unsteady inflow.

paragraphs.en: RL training requires a large number of interactions with the environment. Running these interactions with FAST.Farm would therefore result in a prohibitive computational cost. Therefore, we use FLORIS during training, which provides a much lower computational cost. The resulting policies are then evaluated using FAST.Farm to assess their performance in a higher-fidelity, time-resolved environment.

paragraphs.en: Ebrahimi et al. [15] highlight the differences in predicted wake losses between FLORIS and FAST.Farm, and propose a recalibration of the FLORIS models. It is also common in the industry to calibrate low-fidelity models with field measurements to improve accuracy. We perform a similar calibration to reduce the model mismatch in power between the simulators and help the transfer from FLORIS to FAST.Farm.

paragraphs.en: The acoustic impact of the wind farm is assessed using noise prediction models, as described in [ 45 ] . There are different approaches to prediction of wind turbine noise. FAST.Farm has a semi-empirical method implemented based on the BPM model, [ 7 ] . This would be a Class II noise prediction code according to the classification proposed by Lowson [24] . This class of methods is generally considered to be a mid-fidelity approach capable of capturing the main noise-generation mechanisms of wind turbines. These methods use the output of the BEM codes to account for the influence of turbine operating conditions on the predicted noise levels.

paragraphs.en: This model for wind turbine noise considers several contributing factors. The dominant contribution is the blade tip speed, defined as V tip = Ω ​ R V_{\mathrm{tip}}=\Omega R , where Ω \Omega is the rotational speed and R R is the rotor radius (or blade length). Other relevant parameters include the rotor diameter D D , the solidity of the wind turbine rotor σ = n B ​ A B / A R \sigma=n_{B}A_{B}/A_{R} and the thrust coefficient C T C_{T} . The model assumes spherical sound propagation, resulting in a decay rate of 1 / | 𝒙 | 1/\lvert\bm{x}\rvert , where | 𝒙 | \lvert\bm{x}\rvert is the distance to the source (i.e., the rotor center). These contributions are weighted by the coefficients proposed by Hagg [17] via calibration with experiments, C 1 = 63.3 C_{1}=63.3 , C 2 = 11.5 C_{2}=11.5 , C 3 = 2.5 C_{3}=2.5 , C 4 = 20 C_{4}=20 , C 5 = 10 C_{5}=10 and C 6 = 27.5 C_{6}=27.5 . Finally, we incorporate an enforced directivity function 𝒟 ⁡ ( 𝒙 ) = cos ⁡ θ \mathcal{D}(\bm{x})=\cos\theta to recover the dipole radiation pattern aligned with the rotor axis.

paragraphs.en: In this section, an RL agent is trained using FLORIS, along with the low-fidelity noise model developed in Subsection 2.4 . The training process consisted of 300k steps (interactions with the solver FLORIS) divided in episodes of 500 steps. In each episode, a random steady wind speed is picked between 8 and 15 m s − 1 \mathrm{m}\text{\,}{\mathrm{s}}^{-1} , covering both under- and above rated wind conditions. The wind direction remains constant and aligned to the wind turbine rows throughout all episodes.

paragraphs.en: Noise reduced operation, NRO . Industry standard mode for noise reduction. The variable-speed controller of each wind turbine is derated by reducing the rated rotor speed to mitigate noise emissions at the expense of power production [ 44 ] . In practice, this results in a curtailed power curve. A uniform derating across the wind farm is considered. To achieve a noise level of 40 dB 40\text{\,}\mathrm{dB} within the control region, the minimum uniform derating is determined for each wind speed by iteratively decreasing the power setpoints until the noise constraint is met.

paragraphs.en: Figure 3 illustrates the wind speed sweep of the wind farm power output and the noise level for the three control strategies. The greedy control achieves the highest wind farm power output; however, it exceeds the noise constraint for wind speeds above 10 m s − 1 \mathrm{m}\text{\,}{\mathrm{s}}^{-1} . In contrast, the NRO control strategy satisfies 40 dB 40\text{\,}\mathrm{dB} threshold by design, but substantially limits wind farm power generation. The uniform power setpoints commanded by the NRO strategy to the turbines range from 4 MW 4\text{\,}\mathrm{MW} at 10 m s − 1 \mathrm{m}\text{\,}{\mathrm{s}}^{-1} to 3.4 MW 3.4\text{\,}\mathrm{MW} at 15 m s − 1 \mathrm{m}\text{\,}{\mathrm{s}}^{-1} . At 15 m s − 1 \mathrm{m}\text{\,}{\mathrm{s}}^{-1} , the NRO strategy produces approximately 20 MW 20\text{\,}\mathrm{MW} , corresponding to only 2/3 of the available power. This control strategy exhibits an average power deficit of 17% relative to greedy control over the wind speed sweep.

paragraphs.en: To investigate how the agent achieves this performance, we now look at the actions chosen for the same wind sweep at the end of each wind episode. 4(a) shows the yaw angles reached by the six wind turbines for the different wind speeds, while 4(b) presents the power generated by each turbine and indicates the turbines for which a power setpoint actively limits the power.
paragraphs.zh: 为了研究智能体是如何实现这一性能的，我们现在考察在每次风况试验结束时，同一风速扫描下所选择的动作。4(a) 展示了六台风力机在不同风速下达到的偏航角，而 4(b) 给出了每台风力机所产生的功率，并标示出哪些风力机的功率受到了功率设定点的主动限制。

paragraphs.en: Firstly, for yaw control ( 4(a) ), at low wind speeds, the strategy is similar to conventional power-maximizing wake steering [ 18 , 28 ] . In fact, up to 11 m s − 1 \mathrm{m}\text{\,}{\mathrm{s}}^{-1} , the Noise Steering agent achieves a slight increase in power output of approximately 400 kW 400\text{\,}\mathrm{kW} relative to greedy control (see 3(a) ) as a result of this wake steering strategy. The front and mid turbines of both rows exhibit similar yaw angles around − 20 ° -20\text{\,}\mathrm{\SIUnitSymbolDegree} , while both last turbines face the wind (around 0 ° 0\text{\,}\mathrm{\SIUnitSymbolDegree} yaw). This strategy deviates from the wakes of the two front turbines to decrease the negative impact of their velocity deficit. At higher wind speeds, a similar power maximisation objective would breach the acoustic constraint. Therefore, the learned strategy consists of a low yaw angle (between − 10 ° -10\text{\,}\mathrm{\SIUnitSymbolDegree} and 10 ° 10\text{\,}\mathrm{\SIUnitSymbolDegree} ) for both mid turbines and a positive yaw angle for both last two turbines (respectively, 34 ° 34\text{\,}\mathrm{\SIUnitSymbolDegree} and 18 ° 18\text{\,}\mathrm{\SIUnitSymbolDegree} at 15 m s − 1 \mathrm{m}\text{\,}{\mathrm{s}}^{-1} ). This can be explained as the turbines preferentially yawing in the direction that aligns their rotor planes with the acoustic region, corresponding to a direction of reduced radiation due to the dipole-like directivity of the wind turbine noise.
paragraphs.zh: 首先，对于偏航控制（4(a)），在低风速下，该策略与传统的最大化功率的尾流转向策略[18, 28]类似。 事实上，在风速最高达11 m s⁻¹时，Noise Steering智能体通过这种尾流转向策略，相对于贪婪控制实现了约400 kW的功率输出小幅提升（见3(a)）。 两排的前部和中部风机表现出约−20°的相似偏航角，而两排的最后一台风机则面向风（偏航角约0°）。 该策略使尾流偏离前两台风机，以降低其速度亏损的负面影响。 在更高风速下，类似的功率最大化目标将违反声学约束。 因此，学习到的策略包括：两台中部风机采用较小的偏航角（介于−10°和10°之间），最后两台风机采用正偏航角（在15 m s⁻¹时分别为34°和18°）。 这可以解释为风机优先朝使其 rotor 平面与声学区域对齐的方向偏航，由于风机噪声的类偶极子指向性，该方向对应于辐射降低的方向。

paragraphs.en: To further explain the Noise Steering policy, the wind farm flow and acoustic fields are presented in Figure 5 for the highest wind speed considered in the sweep, 15 m s − 1 \mathrm{m}\text{\,}{\mathrm{s}}^{-1} . paragraphs.en: Overall, the Noise Steering policy achieves power levels comparable to those of the greedy control while substantially reducing noise emissions. paragraphs.en: The Noise Steering strategy achieves a similar power output when deployed in FAST.Farm as in FLORIS (see 6(a) ). paragraphs.en: This work introduced Noise Steering , a farm-level control strategy that jointly exploits yaw misalignment and power derating to maximise wind farm power under a localised noise constraint. In this work, we chose Reinforcement Learning as a method to perform Noise Steering , as it has the potential to provide a model-free closed loop controller.
paragraphs.zh: 本工作提出了噪声导向（Noise Steering），这是一种场级控制策略，联合利用偏航失准与功率降额，在局部噪声约束下最大化风电场功率。 在本工作中，我们选择强化学习作为执行噪声导向（Noise Steering）的方法，因为它有潜力提供一种无模型的闭环控制器。

sents.en: This work introduced Noise Steering , a farm-level control strategy that jointly exploits yaw misalignment and power derating to maximise wind farm power under a localised noise constraint.
sents.zh: 本工作提出了噪声导向（Noise Steering），这是一种场级控制策略，联合利用偏航失准与功率降额，在局部噪声约束下最大化风电场功率。

sents.en: In this work, we chose Reinforcement Learning as a method to perform Noise Steering , as it has the potential to provide a model-free closed loop controller.
sents.zh: 在本工作中，我们选择强化学习作为执行噪声导向（Noise Steering）的方法，因为它有潜力提供一种无模型的闭环控制器。

paragraphs.en: A low-fidelity aeroacoustic model, combining the analytical model of Hagg [17] with an enforced dipole directivity, is coupled to the steady-state FLORIS simulator to enable RL training. Farm noise emissions are thereby estimated at the same order of computational cost as the flow field, making RL training tractable. A PPO agent is trained on a six-turbine farm to maximise power while keeping the sound level below 40 dB 40\text{\,}\mathrm{dB} in a control region located 4 ​ D 4D from the closest turbine row.
paragraphs.zh: 将一个低保真气动声学模型（结合了 Hagg [17] 的解析模型与强制的偶极子指向性）与稳态 FLORIS 仿真器耦合，以支持强化学习训练。 由此，风电场噪声排放可以以与流场计算同阶的计算成本进行估算，从而使强化学习训练变得可行。 在一个六风机风电场上训练一个 PPO 智能体，以最大化功率输出，同时使距离最近风机下风 4D 处控制区域内的声级保持在 40\text{\,}\mathrm{dB} 以下。

sents.en: A low-fidelity aeroacoustic model, combining the analytical model of Hagg [17] with an enforced dipole directivity, is coupled to the steady-state FLORIS simulator to enable RL training.
sents.zh: 将一个低保真气动声学模型（结合了 Hagg [17] 的解析模型与强制的偶极子指向性）与稳态 FLORIS 仿真器耦合，以支持强化学习训练。

sents.en: Farm noise emissions are thereby estimated at the same order of computational cost as the flow field, making RL training tractable.
sents.zh: 由此，风电场噪声排放可以以与流场计算同阶的计算成本进行估算，从而使强化学习训练变得可行。

sents.en: A PPO agent is trained on a six-turbine farm to maximise power while keeping the sound level below 40 dB 40\text{\,}\mathrm{dB} in a control region located 4 ​ D 4D from the closest turbine row.
sents.zh: 在一个六风机风电场上训练一个 PPO 智能体，以最大化功率输出，同时使距离最近风机下风 4D 处控制区域内的声级保持在 40\text{\,}\mathrm{dB} 以下。

paragraphs.en: The learnt policy satisfies the noise constraint throughout the 8-15 m s − 1 \mathrm{m}\text{\,}{\mathrm{s}}^{-1} range, with an average power deficit of only 2% relative to greedy control and a maximum of 7.7% at the highest wind speed, compared to an average 17% for the baseline NRO. The Noise Steering agent combines two complementary mechanisms. At low wind speeds, it reproduces conventional power-maximising wake steering. At higher wind speeds, it orients the rotor planes towards the control region, so that the dipole-like directivity of the turbine noise radiates away from it.
paragraphs.zh: 所学策略在整个 8-15 m s − 1 \mathrm{m}\text{\,}{\mathrm{s}}^{-1} 风速范围内均满足噪声约束，相对于贪婪控制的平均功率损失仅为 2%，最高风速下的最大损失为 7.7%，而基线 NRO 的平均损失为 17%。 噪声引导智能体结合了两种互补的机制。 在低风速下，它复现了传统的功率最大化尾流引导。 在较高风速下，它将风轮平面转向控制区域，使风机的偶极子指向性噪声远离该区域辐射。

sents.zh: 所学策略在整个 8-15 m s − 1 \mathrm{m}\text{\,}{\mathrm{s}}^{-1} 风速范围内均满足噪声约束，相对于贪婪控制的平均功率损失仅为 2%，最高风速下的最大损失为 7.7%，而基线 NRO 的平均损失为 17%。

sents.zh: 在较高风速下，它将风轮平面转向控制区域，使风机的偶极子指向性噪声远离该区域辐射。

paragraphs.en: Deployed without retraining in the higher-fidelity, time-resolved FAST.Farm solver under steady inflow, the policy exhibits similar power performance and remains below the noise limit at all but the highest wind speed. This indicates that the calibrated steady-state training environment is representative enough for transfer to the dynamic environment. However, the transferred policy appears too conservative and additional power could be produced under the noise constraint. This is a consequence of model-mismatch between the simulators, which could hence be mitigated in future studies by enabling the RL agent to continue learning online in the higher-fidelity environment.
paragraphs.zh: 在稳态入流条件下，该策略无需再训练即可部署到保真度更高、具备时间分辨率的 FAST.Farm 求解器中，其功率表现相近，并且在除最高风速外的所有风速下均保持在噪声限值以下。 这表明经过校准的稳态训练环境具有足够的代表性，可以迁移到动态环境中。 然而，迁移后的策略显得过于保守，在噪声约束下本可以产生更多的功率。 这是仿真器之间模型失配所导致的结果，因此在未来研究中可以通过让强化学习智能体在更高保真度的环境中继续在线学习来缓解这一问题。

paragraphs.en: The policy is further evaluated under an unsteady and turbulent wind inflow. Although trained exclusively under steady inflow, the Noise Steering policy manages to respect the noise constraint under varying wind conditions. It exhibits only transient noise constraint violations while retaining 92% of greedy power, thus improving conventional NRO power generation by 10%.
paragraphs.zh: 该策略进一步在不稳定且湍流的风入流条件下进行了评估。 尽管仅在稳定入流条件下训练，Noise Steering 策略在变化的 wind conditions 下仍能遵守噪声约束。 它仅出现瞬态的噪声约束违反，同时保留了 92% 的贪心功率，从而使传统 NRO 发电提升 10%。

paragraphs.en: These results are obtained for a single wind direction, a fixed control region, and an acoustic model that neglects propagation effects such as ground reflection, refraction, and atmospheric absorption. Including unsteady inflow during training could further improve performance. The low-fidelity environment is also pre-calibrated to reduce model-mismatch with the higher-fidelity environment. The impact of relaxing those hypotheses should be assessed in future work.
paragraphs.zh: 这些结果是针对单一风向、固定控制区域以及忽略了地面反射、折射和大气吸收等传播效应的声学模型得到的。 在训练中纳入非定常来流可能会进一步提高性能。 低保真环境也经过了预先校准，以减少与更高保真环境之间的模型失配。 放宽这些假设的影响应在未来工作中加以评估。

paragraphs.en: Given the energy production currently lost to acoustic curtailment [ 46 ] , we believe that wind farm control that takes advantage of wake interactions and acoustic directivity is a highly promising direction.

paragraphs.en: The low-fidelity wind turbine noise model developed in Subsection 2.4 is validated against the semi-empirical method implemented in FAST.Farm under three different operating conditions. To assess the complete modelling chain, three modelling approaches are compared. First, the mid-fidelity FAST.Farm + BPM approach is considered as the ground truth. Second, the effect of changing only the aeroacoustic model is evaluated using the wind farm operating conditions provided by FAST.Farm, resulting in the FAST.Farm + Hagg [17] approach. Finally, the lower-fidelity approach used for training, namely FLORIS + Hagg [17] , is evaluated.

paragraphs.en: These results indicate that, despite being trained in a steady-state solver, the RL policy is able to operate under the transient wake dynamics of FAST.Farm once the static modelling discrepancy between the two environments has been reduced through calibration.
paragraphs.zh: 这些结果表明，尽管强化学习策略是在稳态求解器中训练的，但通过校准减小了两个环境之间的静态建模差异后，该策略仍能够在 FAST.Farm 的瞬态尾流动力学下运行。
